query:
INSERT INTO leadSequenceQueue (leadId, sequenceKey, touchKey, scheduledAt, status, createdAt)
SELECT 
  l.id,
  'summer_camp_nurture',
  'day_0_camp_overview',
  NOW(),
  'pending',
  NOW()
FROM leads l
WHERE l.email IS NOT NULL
  AND l.email != ''
  AND (l.tags IS NULL OR l.tags NOT LIKE '%do_not_contact%')
  AND LOWER(TRIM(l.programInterest)) IN (
    'summer camp 2026', 'summer_camp', 'summer camp', 'summer'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM campRegistrations cr
    WHERE LOWER(cr.email) = LOWER(l.email)
    AND cr.stripePaymentStatus = 'succeeded'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM leadSequenceQueue q
    WHERE q.leadId = l.id
    AND q.sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
    AND q.status IN ('sent', 'queued', 'pending')
  );
